title: First Battle of Trenton, 26 December 1776
subtitle: Washington's march from the Delaware and the fight for the town
opening_text: Christmas evening: Washington's army stands behind McKonkey's Ferry on the Pennsylvania bank and begins to cross the ice-choked Delaware. The crossing runs through the night, about three hours late; on the New Jersey bank the army forms in two divisions, Greene's and Sullivan's.

title: Battle of Cowpens, 17 January 1781
subtitle: Morgan's three lines and the double envelopment of Tarleton
opening_text: Before daylight on 17 January 1781. Daniel Morgan's detachment is in camp at the Cowpens, a well-known pasture ground on the Green River Road. Banastre Tarleton, sent by Cornwallis to destroy it, has been marching since three in the morning and is five miles off. Morgan has chosen to stand here. Press play: the units come onto the map as they form.

title: South Carolina, April 1775 to Cowpens, 17 January 1781
subtitle: Who fought where, who won, and who held the towns and forts, month by month
opening_text: South Carolina, early 1775: the royal government still stands. Press play and the fights come onto the map month by month, each drawn for the side that won it.
